about: Where each app paints its own interface over a full-screen frame. Every box is [x, y, width, height] as fractions of the frame (0 to 1), from the top-left. Keep text, logos and the product out of these boxes.

zones.name: TikTok feed (9:16)
zones.method: Measured off the app's layout in September 2026 and kept generous. TikTok also publishes safe-zone overlays for ads in TikTok Ads Manager.

zones.name: Instagram Reels (9:16)
zones.method: Measured off the app's layout in September 2026 and kept generous.

zones.name: YouTube Shorts (9:16)
zones.method: Measured off the app's layout in September 2026 and kept generous.

zones.name: Meta Story and Reels ads (9:16)
zones.method: Meta's ads guide: leave about 14% at the top, 35% at the bottom and 6% at each side free of text and logos.

zones.name: YouTube channel banner
zones.method: YouTube's channel branding help: the centre 1235 x 338 of a 2048 x 1152 banner shows everywhere; the rest is cropped on phones.
